name: range
title: Range
description: Material range slider with the signature value bubble, multiple thumbs, steps and vertical orientation.
improvements: Built on Radix Slider: real role="slider" thumbs with arrow, Page Up/Down and Home/End keys, touch and pointer support.
Two or more thumbs for selecting a range, which native input[type=range] could not do.
The value bubble also appears for keyboard users, and its text and aria-valuetext can be formatted (currency, units).
Controlled values update the thumbs and the bubble; name submits the value with the form.
Vertical orientation, disabled state and reduced motion support.
